description: Edit a frame animation (Timeline panel in frame mode): new, delete, copy, paste, reverse or tween frames, select a frame, make frames from layers, flatten frames into layers, match a layer across frames, delete the animation, and the New Layers options. Tween and Paste Frames use the dialog's last settings

command.description: The command to run on the selected frames

frame.description: For select_frame: the frame number, 1 for the first

matchPosition.description: For match_layer: match the active layer's position. Default true

matchStyle.description: For match_layer: match its layer style. Default true

matchVisibility.description: For match_layer: match its visibility. Default true

name: edit_frame_animation
title: Edit Frame Animation
